title: Machine Shop Production Manager
description:
**Who we need? – Production Manager**

- We are seeking an experienced and proactive Production Manager to lead the entire production function across departments such as Machine Shop - Lathe, Traub, Drilling & Tapping, CNC, VMC, Press Shop, Assembly, Polishing, Plating, and Coating.

- The ideal candidate must have strong leadership skills, process knowledge, and experience in managing large-scale production in the hardware or engineering components industry.

**What will a Production Manager do?**

- Oversee and manage daily production operations across all departments to ensure timely delivery and quality output.

- Plan, schedule, and execute production activities based on PPC inputs, ensuring optimal use of manpower, machines, and materials.

- Drive productivity, reduce cycle time, and ensure zero-defect manufacturing.

- Coordinate with departments including PPC, Quality, Maintenance, Design, Stores, and Dispatch for smooth operations.

- Ensure compliance with SOPs, work instructions, safety standards, and 5S across the shop floor.

- Monitor and control rejection, rework, downtime, and production wastage.

- Lead daily production meetings and resolve bottlenecks in real-time.

- Maintain production KPIs and MIS reports including output, utilization, efficiency, and OEE.

- Train and mentor supervisors, operators, and technical staff to enhance skills and performance.

- Implement lean manufacturing, continuous improvement (Kaizen), and cost-saving initiatives.

- Review machine performance and ensure preventive maintenance adherence.

- Support NPD and sample trials in coordination with the design and tooling departments.

- Ensure compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and audit requirements.

**An efficient Production Manager should have:**

- Strong technical understanding of manufacturing processes like CNC & VMC machining, gun-drill, band-saw machining, lathre, traub, pressing, plating, polishing, and coating.

- Proven ability to manage production planning, execution, and workforce handling.

- Excellent leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

- Data-driven approach with strong analytical and reporting capabilities.

- Familiarity with ERP systems and production reporting tools.

- Ability to work under pressure and handle high-volume production environments.

- Strong interdepartmental coordination and communication skills.

**Minimum Education Requirements:**

- Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Mechanical, Production, or Industrial Engineering.

- Minimum 8–12 years of experience in production management, preferably in the hardware fittings, auto components, or metal processing industry.

- Experience in managing a large team and multi-department operations.

- Proficiency in MS Office and ERP software is essential.

Location: Neemrana, Rajasthan

Job Type: Full-time

Workplace: In-office

**Salary: Can be discussed**

**﻿**
Working Hours: as per company need.

title: Dispatch Supervisor
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for an experienced Dispatch Supervisor to manage and coordinate day-to-day dispatch operations, ensuring timely and accurate shipment of materials, machinery and equipment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Manage dispatch planning, packing, loading and shipment activities.

- Coordinate with production, stores, logistics teams and transporters.

- Ensure proper dispatch documentation, material tracking and delivery records.

- Monitor dispatch schedules and ensure timely deliveries.

- Maintain inventory and dispatch records.

**Requirements:**

- 4–5+ years of relevant experience in dispatch and logistics operations.

- Knowledge of material handling, packing and transportation.

- Good coordination, communication and documentation skills.

- ITI / Diploma or Graduate qualification preferred.

- Experience in manufacturing or industrial automation will be an advantage.

title: Manager-Production
description:
**DIMENSION / SCOPE OF THE JOB:**
To lead Manufacturing Activities in each production line to meet customer expectations with utmost Safe Working Culture, Zero Defect Strategy and Improved Productivity & OAE. To ensure Flawless, On time product delivery to all OE, OEMs & aftermarket Customers. Leading lean initiatives in shop floor to improve on overall plant performance as per Global Standards.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Drives the development of Operations strategies & align with global operations strategies
* Coordinates production, distribution, warehousing, in accordance with policies, principles, and procedures.
* Reviews production costs and product quality and modifies production and inventory control programs to maintain and enhance profitable operation of division.
* Capability enhancement of team thru training and learning initiatives, performance management & talent management.
* Address issues and resolve problems where analysis of the situation or data requires an in-depth knowledge of end goals and objectives for the department or area managed.
* Provide input and ideas for improvement to internal processes to streamline work, improve quality and reduce the likelihood of errors and problems.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of employees or lead the functional area and collaborate with others inside and outside the company.
* Accountable for setting a department budget and making sure it is adhered to.

title: Quality Control Prof Senior
description:
Fully On\-Site
   

  

**(Male/Female)**
**Location\- Rajgangpur,Odisha \- India \| Full\-Time**
**Are you ready to take on new challenges in a dynamic, international, and innovation\-driven environment where you can truly make an impact?**
 We are hiring a dedicated and proactive Quality Control Manager. Head of Quality Control is responsible for auditing, monitoring, and determining the quality of manufacturing processes and outputs against defined internal standards, customer specifications, and applicable regulatory requirements. The role leads to quality control operations across incoming materials, in\-process checks, finished product testing, inspection systems, and reporting of manufacturing deviations and product defects. The position works closely with Quality Assurance, Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Plant Leadership to investigate issues, implement corrective and preventive actions, and strengthen process discipline and product consistency.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Skills**
* B.Tech / University Degree level
* Experience of Refractory Products.
* 15\+ years of experience.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem\-solving skills.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the Quality Control function for raw materials, in\-process materials, finished goods, and testing activities across the manufacturing operation.
* Establish, review, and improve quality control procedures, specifications, sampling plans, test methods, and inspection standards.
* Audit and monitor manufacturing processes and outputs to ensure compliance with internal standards, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Approve or reject materials and finished products based on inspection and test results, and ensure proper segregation and control of non\-conforming products.
* Report process deviations, product defects, and adverse quality trends to relevant stakeholders and coordinate timely corrective and preventive action closure.
* Liaise with Quality Assurance, Production, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams to troubleshoot quality failures and implement sustainable solutions.
* Oversee laboratory controls, testing schedules, instrument calibration, maintenance, and reliability of inspection and testing equipment, where applicable.
* Review quality performance metrics, analyze defects and variation trends, and recommend process improvements to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
* Lead customer complaint analysis, internal quality investigations, and audit readiness for internal, customer, and regulatory reviews.
* Develop team capability through training, supervision, and performance management of inspectors, analysts, engineers, and quality control
* QA/QC SWI implementation.
* Good Communication Skills in Hindi \& English.
* Computer Skills. (Knowledge of using MS word, excel, power point.)
* Fluency in writing and speaking Hindi, English; every additional language will be considered an asset.
* Ensure safety.


 The role requires recognized expertise in quality control systems, manufacturing inspection practices, root cause analysis, process discipline, and interpretation of specifications and testing results. It also requires the ability to apply experienced judgement in varied operating situations while balancing product quality, customer expectations, process capability, and business needs.
   

  

**Key Skills and** 
**Competencies: \-**
* Quality control systems and inspection planning.
* Root cause analysis, CAPA, and problem\-solving.
* Data analysis, trend review, and reporting.
* Team leadership and cross\-functional coordination.


**What We Bring To The Table**
* Permanent contract with a competitive package (incl. bonus)
* Dedicated development path and continuous learning opportunities (e.g. RHIM Academy LMS, the full LinkedIn Learning catalog, Internal Mentoring Program).
* Flat hierarchies and short decision\-making processes.
* Possibility of business trips (based on organizational needs \& requirements).
* Various social benefits such as Group Medical/ Group Personal Accident/ Group Term Insurance, Mobile Handset/ Mobile Bill Reimbursement, etc.


**Sounds like you?**
 Please apply online – we are looking forward to your application. Due to data privacy reasons applications via e\-mail cannot be taken into consideration.
   

  

**At RHI Magnesita, everyone is welcome!** 
 We embrace diversity in all forms and evaluate applications solely based on qualifications and experience. If you share our passion for shaping tomorrow’s world, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We also actively encourage individuals with disabilities to submit their application.
   

  

**About RHI Magnesita**
 As the global leader in refractories, we supply advanced products, technologies and services essential for high\-temperature industrial processes in sectors such as steel, cement, and glass. With around 20,000 employees and production sites across the globe, we are committed to fostering innovation, sustainability, and market leadership. By leading the industry in reducing emissions and supporting our customers' transitions to greener solutions, we are shaping tomorrow’s world.
